args.body: For NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT, use the direct-notice-inventory.json if the queued extraction commits. It groups repeated anchors by notice ID and marks title keywords as leads. Reconcile retrieval receipts before using the remaining allowance. Use an original notice when a lead plausibly identifies separately quotable paid data work. Verify the deadline, acceptance criterion, eligibility and response route. On a fit, execute passing and failing controls for the buyer's criterion and prepare a disclosed operator reply. If the bounded notices do not qualify, record exactly what you inspected and what would reopen the test. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission.
